basic_details.job_title: IIT (BHU) Project Research Scientist 1 Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

age_limit.age_details: Maximum 35 years (as on the date of application)

qualification.education_qualification: Master's degree (M.Tech./M.Pharm.) in Ceramic Engineering/Pharmaceutical Sciences/Materials Science/Life Sciences, or another relevant interdisciplinary field from a recognized University/Institute
qualification.details: Qualification: Master's degree (M.Tech./M.Pharm.) in Ceramic Engineering/Pharmaceutical Sciences/Materials Science/Life Sciences, or another relevant interdisciplinary field from a recognized University/Institute Age limit: Maximum 35 years (as on the date of application) Age relaxation: SC/ST/Physically Handicapped/Female As per applicable ICMR / Government of India rules | Other conditions: | Candidate is expected to join immediately, if selected | Desirable: | Experience in biomaterials, polymer-based materials, nanomaterials, animal handling, nerve regeneration, drug delivery Experience in material characterization, biological assays, molecular biology, histopathological analysis, or evaluation of biomaterials for biomedical applications is considered advantageous

salary_details.pay_scale: Rs.56,000 + 20% HRA per month (as per ICMR norms) = Rs. 67,200 per month

how_to_apply: Prepare the application in the enclosed format with name, permanent and correspondence address, names of father and mother, telephone number, e-mail address and details of educational career starting from High School or equivalent.
Attach self-attested copies of all mark-sheets and certificates and details of any research or other experience.
Write "Application for Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical) in ICMR funded project" in the subject line of the email.
Send the application to the PI and Co-PI at [email protected] and [email protected] so that it reaches within 21 days of the advertisement.
Email it on or before 18 December 2026.

content_sections.heading: IIT (BHU) Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. EMDR/SG/16/2026-01-02892 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download IIT (BHU) notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Master's degree (M.Tech./M.Pharm.) in Ceramic Engineering/Pharmaceutical Sciences/Materials Science/Life Sciences, or another relevant interdisciplinary field from a recognized University/Institute Age limit: Maximum 35 years (as on the date of application) Age relaxation: SC/ST/Physically Handicapped/Female As per applicable ICMR / Government of India rules Other conditions: Candidate is expected to join immediately, if selected Desirable: Experience in biomaterials, polymer-based materials, nanomaterials, animal handling, nerve regeneration, drug delivery Experience in material characterization, biological assays, molecular biology, histopathological analysis, or evaluation of biomaterials for biomedical applications is considered advantageous

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Fellowship/salary as per ICMR norms. Post is purely temporary and co-terminus with the project Duration of position: 1 year, extendable based on performance Project is sanctioned up to three (03) years No TA/DA is paid for attending the interview

content_sections.heading: How Will IIT (BHU) Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Shortlisting of applications by the PI and Co-PI Interview of shortlisted candidates The PI and Co-PI may restrict the number of candidates called for interview, based on qualifications and experience higher than the minimum prescribed Only shortlisted candidates are communicated to appear for the interview Shortlisted candidates are intimated by email

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Application in the enclosed format Self-attested copies of all mark-sheets and certificates Details of any research or other experience List of publications with impact factor according to JCR, if any Names and addresses of two referees with phone numbers and e-mail addresses Photograph on the application form

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IIT (BHU) Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 18 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in IIT (BHU) Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Project Research Scientist-1 (Non-medical).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for IIT (BHU) Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: By email to [email protected], on or before 18 December 2026. There is no online form.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 35 years (as on the date of application). Relaxation: SC/ST/Physically Handicapped/Female As per applicable ICMR / Government of India rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs.56,000 + 20% HRA per month (as per ICMR norms) = Rs. 67,200 per month.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Master's degree (M.Tech./M.Pharm.) in Ceramic Engineering/Pharmaceutical Sciences/Materials Science/Life Sciences, or another relevant interdisciplinary field from a recognized University/Institute.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidate is expected to join immediately, if selected.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Shortlisting of applications by the PI and Co-PI. Interview of shortlisted candidates. The PI and Co-PI may restrict the number of candidates called for interview, based on qualifications and experience higher than the minimum prescribed. Only shortlisted candidates are communicated to appear for the interview.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Post is purely temporary and co-terminus with the project. Duration of position: 1 year, extendable based on performance. Project is sanctioned up to three (03) years.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
